page.overview:
Who is Elric Tavelle?

was the eldest son of a family of performers of the Greying Wildlands, and the older brother of Lucien Tavelle.

The last memories Lucien had of him were of Elric stiff and ever-smiling, with jet-black eyes that twinkled eyes like beads, always followed by the smell of new shoes.

Elric was a cheerful and helpful boy with a good memory, enthusiastic about his work.

Elric was born at some point before 810 PD as the first son of a married couple of the Greying Wildlands. He had an younger brother, Lucien, and a younger sister, Aldreda. Their parents were artists who usually played music while their children danced, sang or performed plays; Elric was the best performer of all of them, he always remembered his line, and was generally seen as the favorite. However, he had abusive parents who, despite their predilection for him, harshly punished him when they were disappointed, being his younger siblings the ones who consoled him, while they tried to protect themselves from their patents' wrath.
